title: P8 b10 arm M target 6 (CBR)
text:
Target 6/9: CBR (Ki). Reach the best locked quality you can within 10 search draws.

role: memory only: reuse prior experience; do not propose harness changes
labels: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/chembl/cannabinoid_receptor/ki/dataset_p7b.csv
library: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/zinc/library_100k.smi
split: pass /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/chembl/cannabinoid_receptor/ki/splits/frozen_p8_cannabinoid_receptor.json as --split-manifest to ml.train (validation is ~30% of the label set)

space: call search.space first. It lists the 100 configurations you may train.
budget: 10 draws for this ticket. Every ml.train must carry --config-id <id>, --budget-limit 10 and --workspace . ; the tool refuses draw 11.
You may stop before the budget is spent. Stopping early is a result, not a failure.
store: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/experience/experience_p8_m_b10.json (the `store` argument of experience.retrieve)

finish: call evaluation.locked exactly once, on the model you would actually ship (the same one screening.rank used). The collector re-runs it if the shipped model differs from your best, so ship deliberately.

Report: configurations drawn and why you stopped; validation and locked AUROC of the shipped model; wall clock and job count; experience ids reused.
